legend: You are given a sorted array a$$$a$$$ of length n$$$n$$$ in non-decreasing order. Array elements do not exceed n$$$n$$$. You only know the length of the array. Using no more than 2⋅n$$$2 \cdot n$$$ queries, you need to guess the entire array. Queries can be made of the following type: «? i x», where 1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$ and x$$$x$$$ is an integer. The jury will respond as follows:
After you determine the array, you must output it as follows: «! a1$$$a_1$$$ a2$$$a_2$$$ ... an$$$a_n$$$», where a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ are the elements of the array that you guessed.
input: The only line of input contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤3000)$$$(1 \leq n \leq 3000)$$$ - the size of the array.
output: Output your answer in the format «! a1$$$a_1$$$ a2$$$a_2$$$ ... an$$$a_n$$$».
Output your queries in the format «? i x».
The jury will respond with one of three characters: «=» if ai=x$$$a_i = x$$$, «>» if x>ai$$$x  \gt  a_i$$$, or «<» if x<ai$$$x  \lt  a_i$$$.
Output your answer in the format «! a1$$$a_1$$$ a2$$$a_2$$$ ... an$$$a_n$$$».

legend.ai: 给定一个长度为 n$$$n$$$、按非递减顺序排列的数组 a$$$a$$$。数组元素均不超过 n$$$n$$$。你只知道数组的长度。你需要通过不超过 2⋅n$$$2 \cdot n$$$ 次查询猜出整个数组。查询可以采用以下形式：「? i x」，其中 1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$，且 x$$$x$$$ 是一个整数。评测器将按如下方式回应：
